answers.quote: quote the answer, name exactly what it covers (the item, the commit, the wording) and say when the owner gave it. It lapses when what it covers changes.

answers.quote: Write "I claim X; the failure I fear is Y", then try to produce Y.
answers.why: A strict verification pass (cite file:line, name the feared failure, say what was not checked) is worth a small skill of the reader's own.

answers.quote: Never ask the reviewer to run it for you: that would pass a refused action to another session.
answers.why: Do not route a refused action through another session; the reader's rules do not state it. The rest is pair mechanics or covered by engineering.md rules 2 and 5.

answers.quote: Report what you observed, never the verdict.
answers.why: Hand-off notes carry raw evidence, not self-judgment; the five coding rules in the unit duplicate engineering.md rules 1 to 5.
